plugins.name: bdd
plugins.description: Behaviour-Driven Development toolkit: turn a one-line requirement into Gherkin, review it as an HTML spec report, sketch the UI the features imply - every data state of each page - on a wireframe canvas before any code exists, scaffold cucumber with Playwright for web and Appium for mobile, establish the design system the UI work is built against, plan the work as files on disk and drive it to green with outside-in TDD one capability at a time, run the suite with requirement coverage, derive page and screen flow maps from run screenshots, and generate database DDL from Gherkin.
